long_biography.plain_text:
At ArisGlobal, Sankesh Abbhi joined cloud software with the operational demands of drug development. An economics graduate, he directed the company through a period of platform expansion and investment by Nordic Capital. He later stepped from chief executive into a non-executive board role while retaining a minority interest in the company.

At Sitero, Abbhi returned to hands-on company building. As founder and chief executive, he directs strategy for a business that spans clinical-trial operations, consulting, pharmacovigilance and research oversight. The model reflects his long-running emphasis on pairing specialised regulatory knowledge with technology-enabled services across the drug-development process.
